final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) as film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(film_count) as total_films FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.rating, step1.film_count, CAST(step1.film_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total_films FROM step2) as proportion FROM step1), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.rating, step3.film_count, step3.proportion, step3.proportion - (SELECT avg_proportion FROM step4) as diff FROM step3 WHERE step3.proportion > (SELECT avg_proportion FROM step4)) SELECT SUM(film_count) as sum_films, AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion, AVG(diff) as avg_diff FROM step5
